test_title: PYST 41: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All gowns are shirts.

Some shirts are coats.

All coats are clothes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some gowns are clothes.

II. Some clothes are shirts.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
Given,

Statements:

All gowns are shirts.

Some shirts are coats.

All coats are clothes.

**Venn Diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3bcdf0a8d8accbee27d46ae899b8f087d393089493ef6cd83c52244ae7bc2a9.png] 

**Conclusions**:

I. Some gowns are clothes. → FALSE (Not definite.)

II. Some clothes are shirts. → TRUE (Definite)

Hence, the correct answer is __**option 3.**__
